                path: [32m'/home/user/ecommerce-cart/src/App.tsx'[39m,
                content: [32m"import React from 'react';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'import {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  createRootRoute,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  createRoute,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  createRouter,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  RouterProvider,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  Outlet,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  useNavigate,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  useSearch,\n'[39m +
                  [32m"} from '@tanstack/react-router';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'import {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  QueryClient,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  QueryClientProvider,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  useQuery,\n'[39m +
                  [32m"} from '@tanstack/react-query';\n"[39m +
                  [32m"import { fetchProducts, Product } from './products';\n"[39m +
                  [32m"import './App.css';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Create a client for TanStack Query\n'[39m +
                  [32m'const queryClient = new QueryClient({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  defaultOptions: {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    queries: {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      staleTime: 1000 * 60 * 5, // 5 minutes\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      refetchOnWindowFocus: false,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'});\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Define CartItem and SearchParams interfaces\n'[39m +
                  [32m'interface CartItem {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  productId: number;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  quantity: number;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'interface ProductSearch {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  cart?: CartItem[];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  category?: string;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  search?: string;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Create a root route with search parameter validation\n'[39m +
                  [32m'const rootRoute = createRootRoute({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  validateSearch: (search: Record<string, unknown>): ProductSearch => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    let cart: CartItem[] = [];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (search.cart) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      try {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        let parsed: any;\n'[39m +
                  [32m"        if (typeof search.cart === 'string') {\n"[39m +
                  [32m'          parsed = JSON.parse(search.cart);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        } else {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          parsed = search.cart;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          cart = parsed\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            .map((item: any) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              const productId = Number(item?.productId ?? item?.id);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              const quantity = Number(item?.quantity);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              if (!isNaN(productId) && !isNaN(quantity) && quantity > 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                return { productId, quantity };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              return null;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            })\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            .filter((item): item is CartItem => item !== null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      } catch (e) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"        console.error('Failed to parse cart search param', e);\n"[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    const category = typeof search.category === 'string' ? search.category : undefined;\n"[39m +
                  [32m"    const searchQuery = typeof search.search === 'string' ? search.search : undefined;\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    return { cart, category, search: searchQuery };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  component: RootComponent,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'});\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Header Component displaying a summary of the cart state\n'[39m +
                  [32m'function HeaderCartSummary() {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const search = useSearch({ from: rootRoute.id });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const { data: products } = useQuery({\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    queryKey: ['products'],\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    queryFn: fetchProducts,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const cart = search.cart || [];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const totalItems = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const totalPrice = cart.reduce((sum, item) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const product = products?.find((p) => p.id === item.productId);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    return sum + (product ? product.price * item.quantity : 0);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }, 0);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  return (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    <div className="header-cart-summary">\n'[39m +
                  [32m"      <span>🛒 {totalItems} {totalItems === 1 ? 'item' : 'items'}</span>\n"[39m +
                  [32m'      <span>•</span>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      <span>${totalPrice.toFixed(2)}</span>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    </div>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  );\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'function RootComponent() {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  return (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    <div className="app-container">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      <header className="app-header">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        <div className="header-content">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          <div className="logo-section">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            <span className="logo-emoji">🛒</span>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            <h1 className="app-title">TanStack Shop</h1>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          </div>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          <HeaderCartSummary />\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        </div>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      </header>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      <main className="app-main">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        <Outlet />\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      </main>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      <footer className="app-footer">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        <p>© 2026 TanStack Shop. Built with TanStack Query & TanStack Router.</p>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      </footer>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    </div>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  );\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Create index route\n'[39m +
                  [32m'const indexRoute = createRoute({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,\n'[39m +
                  [32m"  path: '/',\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  component: IndexComponent,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'});\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +

          description: [32m'Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks autonomously.\n'[39m +
            [32m'When using the newTask tool, the agentType parameter is optional. Leave it empty (None) to launch a generic sub agent, or specify one of the available agent types below to select a specialized agent.\n'[39m +
            [32m'Available agent types and the tools they have access to:\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### browser\n'[39m +
            [32m'Web browser automation agent for navigating websites, interacting with pages, and extracting information. Uses agent-browser CLI for browser control, including headless sessions and optional local Chrome auto-connect.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### explore\n'[39m +
            [32m'Use this agent to explore the codebase when you need to: understand project structure, find where features are implemented, locate specific functions or classes, analyze code patterns, investigate how something works, search for examples or usage, or gather information before making changes.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Examples of questions this agent shall trigger:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "where is the authentication logic implemented"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "find all usages of the config parser"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "how does the ignore-walk module work"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### guide\n'[39m +
            [32m"A comprehensive guide for learning about Pochi's capabilities, features, and configuration.\n"[39m +
            [32m'This agent helps users understand how to use Pochi effectively, fetch documentation, and modify their config file (.pochi/config.jsonc) with proper confirmation.\n'[39m +
            [32m"**IMPORTANT: Any request to modify Pochi's configuration must be handled by this agent.**\n"[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Trigger examples:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- General info: "what can Pochi do?", "what agents/tools are available?", "how does Pochi work?"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- Configuration: "how do I configure Pochi?", "explain config options", "help me modify my config", "set up a new provider", "add an MCP server"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- Help & feedback: "join the discord", "report a bug", "where can I get help?"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### planner\n'[39m +
            [32m'Engage this agent to formulate comprehensive, technical implementation strategies for feature development, system refactoring, or defect resolution.\n'[39m +
            [32m'This agent is strictly limited to planning and architectural design; it DOES NOT execute code modifications.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Examples of user requests this agent shall trigger:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "create a plan to implement the user authentication feature"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "how should we refactor the database schema"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "design a solution for the memory leak issue"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### reviewer\n'[39m +
            [32m'Engage this agent to perform code reviews and leave inline comments.\n'[39m +
            [32m'This agent can analyze code and create review comments on specific lines.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Examples of user requests this agent shall trigger:\n'[39m +

            [32m'- "check this code and leave feedback"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Always include a reminder in your prompt to ensure the result will be submitted through the `attemptCompletion` tool.\n'[39m +
            [32m'If the task stops without submitting the result, it will return an error message.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'When NOT to use the newTask tool:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- If you want to read a specific file path, use the readFile or globFiles tool instead of the newTask tool, to find the match more quickly\n'[39m +
            [32m'- If you are searching for a specific class definition like "class Foo", use the globFiles tool instead, to find the match more quickly\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Usage notes:\n'[39m +
            [32m'1. Launch multiple agents tools concurrently whenever possible to maximize performance; to do that, use a single message with multiple tool uses\n'[39m +
            [32m'2. When the agent is done, it will return a single message back to you. The result returned by the agent is not visible to the user. To show the user the result, you should send a text message back to the user with a concise summary of the result.\n'[39m +
            [32m'3. Each agent invocation is stateless. You will not be able to send additional messages to the agent, nor will the agent be able to communicate with you outside of its final report.                   [32m'import {\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  QueryClientProvider,\n'[39m +

                  [32m"} from '@tanstack/react-query';\n"[39m +
                  [32m"import { fetchProducts, Product } from './products';\n"[39m +
                  [32m"import './App.css';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Create a client for TanStack Query\n'[39m +
                  [32m'const queryClient = new QueryClient({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  defaultOptions: {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    queries: {\n'[39m +

                  [32m'    },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'});\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Define CartItem and SearchParams interfaces\n'[39m +
                  [32m'interface CartItem {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  productId: number;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  quantity: number;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'interface ProductSearch {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  cart?: CartItem[];\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  search?: string;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Create a root route with search parameter validation\n'[39m +
                  [32m'const rootRoute = createRootRoute({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  validateSearch: (search: Record<string, unknown>): ProductSearch => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    let cart: CartItem[] = [];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (search.cart) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      try {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        let parsed: any;\n'[39m +
                  [32m"        if (typeof search.cart === 'string') {\n"[39m +
                  [32m'          parsed = JSON.parse(search.cart);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        } else {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          parsed = search.cart;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          cart = parsed\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            .map((item: any) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              const productId = Number(item?.productId ?? item?.id);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              const quantity = Number(item?.quantity);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              if (!isNaN(productId) && !isNaN(quantity) && quantity > 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                return { productId, quantity };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              return null;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            })\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            .filter((item): item is CartItem => item !== null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      } catch (e) {\n'[39m +

                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    const category = typeof search.category === 'string' ? search.category : undefined;\n"[39m +
                  [32m"    const searchQuery = typeof search.search === 'string' ? search.search : undefined;\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    return { cart, category, search: searchQuery };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  },\n'[39m +

                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Header Component displaying a summary of the cart state\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  const { data: products } = useQuery({\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const cart = search.cart || [];\n'[39m +

                  [32m'\n'[39m +

                  [32m'      <span>${totalPrice.toFixed(2)}</span>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    </div>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  );\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'function RootComponent() {\n'[39m +

                  [32m'            <span className="logo-emoji">🛒</span>\n'[39m +

                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Create index route\n'[39m +
                  [32m'const indexRoute = createRoute({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,\n'[39m +
                  [32m"  path: '/',\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  component: IndexComponent,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'});\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'function IndexComponent() {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"  const search = useSearch({ from: '/' });\n"[39m +
                  [32m"  const navigate = useNavigate({ from: '/' });\n"[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  // Fetch products using TanStack Query\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const { data: products, isLoading, error } = useQuery({\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    queryKey: ['products'],\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    queryFn: fetchProducts,\n'[39m +

                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const cart = search.cart || [];\n'[39m +
                  [32m"  const activeCategory = search.category || 'All';\n"[39m +
                  [32m"  const searchQuery = search.search || '';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  // Get unique categories from products\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const categories = React.useMemo(() => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    if (!products) return ['All'];\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    const unique = new Set(products.map((p) => p.category));\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    return ['All', ...Array.from(unique)];\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  }, [products]);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  // Filter products based on activeCategory and searchQuery\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const filteredProducts = React.useMemo(() => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (!products) return [];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    return products.filter((product) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"      const matchesCategory = activeCategory === 'All' || product.category === activeCategory;\n"[39m +
                  [32m'      const matchesSearch =\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        product.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        product.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return matchesCategory && matchesSearch;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }, [products, activeCategory, searchQuery]);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const handleAddToCart = (productId: number) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const existingItem = cart.find((item) => item.productId === productId);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    let newCart: CartItem[];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (existingItem) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      newCart = cart.map((item) =>\n'[39m +

                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const handleUpdateQuantity = (productId: number, newQuantity: number) => {\n'[39m +

                  [32m'      newCart = cart.map((item) =>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        item.productId === productId ? { ...item, quantity: newQuantity } : item\n'[39m +

                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    navigate({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      search: (prev) => ({ ...prev, cart: newCart }),\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const handleRemoveFromCart = (productId: number) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const newCart = cart.filter((item) => item.productId !== productId);\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const handleSearchChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {\n'[39m +

                  [32m'    navigate({\n'[39m +

                  [32m'      }),\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  // Calculate cart totals\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const subtotal = React.useMemo(() => {\n'[39m +

                  [32m'      return sum + (product ? product.price * item.quantity : 0);\n'[39m +

                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const shipping = subtotal > 0 && subtotal < 150 ? 9.99 : 0;\n'[39m +

            [32m'Before executing the command, please follow these steps:\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'# Committing changes with git\n'[39m +
